question: To what kind of recipient is this teaching said to be given, given the stated qualifications?
premises: Something is marked as to be given.
The recipient is described as endowed with all states.
The recipient is further described as one of resolved mind.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The object being given is not named in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
